note: Literature shows MAPK8IP3 variants, including truncating variants and indels, present with neurodevelopmental features including intellectual disability rather than pure HSP.

evidence.text: De novo variants in MAPK8IP3, comprising missense and truncating variants, were identified in 13 unrelated individuals who all presented with an overlapping neurodevelopmental phenotype of mild to severe intellectual disability.

source.title: De novo variants in MAPK8IP3 cause intellectual disability with variable brain anomalies
source.quote: Using exome sequencing, we have identified de novo variants in MAPK8IP3 in 13 unrelated individuals presenting with an overlapping phenotype of mild to severe intellectual disability. The de novo variants comprise six missense variants, three of which are recurrent, and three truncating variants.

evidence.text: A 50 bp deletion in MAPK8IP3 segregating in a family with hereditary spastic paraplegia also presented with dysmorphism and marked intellectual disability.

source.title: Unraveling undiagnosed rare disease cases by HiFi long-read genome sequencing
